## Root reconciliation of the consultation

- Accept aimed interaction, real host cues, new-only Dart heading, impact feedback, deliberate captured look, accurate controls and compact contextual pilot guidance. Preserve handling, existing save shapes/content and strict atomic action rules.
- **No inside-sphere bypass.** The plan's `inside => miss=0` and skipped LOS can select a host behind the eye or through nearby furniture. Hosts must remain in front of the actual view and pass occlusion even at very close range. Forgiveness must not become a behind-camera fallback. Deliberate centered aim at known evidence must win; new-item preference is only for genuinely ambiguous near-ties. Constants are trials, not acceptance rules.
- **One view origin.** Do not accept almost a metre of camera/selection separation during eye easing as harmless. The presentation owner will align the non-piloting camera with the same instantaneous `eyeHeight(state)` used by targeting, retaining opening and hull-local pilot cameras. No broad interpolation or movement easing change.
- **No compulsory WeakMap cache.** Select deterministically on the current state; recomputation over this small roster is acceptable. Never reuse a target across mutable draft commands, mode changes or a replaced state. Prompt, visible host cue and accepted action must agree.
- **Validated panel intent comes from the sim.** Add the transient `interaction-panel` event below for known evidence, cache, disabled-craft and service interactions. Do not let an app-only interception bypass target/LOS/action validation. A known evidence E opens its notebook entry without changing discovery/provenance/recovery feedback. Q remains a scanner action with existing equipment/noise rules and the same target; it does not become a free scanner-less notebook shortcut.
- Preserve explicit `sort-source`, `board`, recovery and panel commands as separate existing actions. Untargeted E can select the exhausted source's appropriate existing sorting/tending action; never promise collection on an empty host. A maintenance-source reserve must retain its special recovery constraints. A depleted host with no useful action is labelled Empty, not Collect. Known evidence/scans return useful repeat feedback without replaying stale saved recovery text as a new success.
- New-only `DART_BUILD_YAW = Math.PI`, assigned by Dart fabrication rather than `makeVehicle` or decoding. Root reran the adviser launch script: yaw0 first contact4.4m, yawπ clear beyond40m and swept25m pass; east/west rails0.6m. These are module diagnostics, not an ordinary new-build launch. Use the earned pre-fabrication checkpoint for the latter in 1B.
- Damaging impacts emit transient positive actual hull loss; no damage formula, velocity, air, power or saved-state changes. Body/equipment feedback remains centered; no invented audible-mix claim.
- Accept a short deliberate exit gesture only as presentation input, with cancellation and immediate emergency escape (disabled/empty power/low hull/low emergency air/pursuit). Never weaken depth/clearance refusal or delay Escape/pause. Do not change saved pitch, add global auto-leveling or impose a hard sim speed lock. 1B owns final gesture tests.
- Slice2 owns menu hierarchy, targeted UI extraction, notice priorities, air/obstruction clarity, creature legibility and rib collision fidelity. Do not add unused future events, a general refactor, mouse easing or physics in 1A. Exact extraction and the true swept rib algorithm will be reconciled before that assignment.
- Rib evidence needs care: root reran the recorded-position probe. Exact stall B blocks with a sampled0.56m visual gap; exact stall A moves0.3m, while the adviser reports blocked nearby samples. The clearance estimate samples points rather than computing full capsule-axis distance. Retain the reported210/254 sweep as an adviser diagnostic, not a proven analytic baseline or a mandatory zero-block target across other solids. The later fix must preserve visible collision and test exact segment geometry/high-speed sweeps, rectangular hull envelopes, custom local query worlds and legacy saves. No auto-push/buoyancy workaround.
- Avoid routine subtitle/helper-copy proliferation. One concise action prompt; preserve useful captions, hazard information, persistence errors, notebook voice and exact protected recovery/provenance strings.

## Frozen interfaces for this slice

1. `src/sim/targeting.ts` exports pure `AimRay { origin: Vec3; dir: Vec3 }`, `InteractionHost { center: Vec3; radius: number; solidIds: readonly string[] }`, `InteractionVerb` (`collect|gather|sort|inspect|review|read|board|recover|open|use|empty`), `AimedTarget extends Interaction { host; verb; known: boolean }`, `aimRay(s): AimRay|null`, `interactionHost(s,t): InteractionHost`, `aimedInteraction(s,world): AimedTarget|null`. Reuse existing interaction enumeration, registry IDs, `eyeHeight` and semantic yaw/pitch. Targeting disabled in opening/piloting/carrier interior; piloting E remains exit.
2. Add required `WorldQueries.lineOfSight(a: Vec3,b: Vec3,ignore?: readonly string[]): boolean`. Use segment/solid intersection, actual `RIB_SEGMENTS` for optical occlusion, and the query's supplied `floorHeight` for terrain. The water plane is transparent. Custom/local query worlds must not accidentally inherit global ribs/terrain. Ignore only the selected host's own mapped geometry; unrelated walls/furniture still occlude. Invalid/nonfinite input fails closed. Movement, clearance and SOLIDS remain unchanged in 1A. A reusable internal rib-distance helper is allowed; no speculative public `ribContact` API is frozen.
3. Add `GameEvent` variants `{ type:'impact'; speed:number; hullLoss:number; origin:Vec3 }` and `{ type:'interaction-panel'; panel:'inventory'|'craft'|'notebook'; targetId:string }`. Both are transient detached values, never saved. Known evidence E produces notebook intent and brief informative feedback without rewriting old saved feedback. Cache/disabled vehicle opens inventory; pod/workshop service opens craft; rescue-staging opens inventory. Action refusal remains atomic and cannot leak a panel event. Explicit `board` retains its refusal semantics. 1B consumes panel events; until then they are ignored safely. No `blocked`/notice-channel or sound union expansion in 1A.
4. Add registry `DART_BUILD_YAW` and optional `INTERACTION_HOSTS` metadata (`offset`, `radius`, host-local `solidIds`) without changing existing ids, positions, provenance, recipes, source yields, saved vehicle headings or hull shapes. Exact per-host metadata must reflect rendered geometry and be returned in the author evidence.
5. 1B may add `GameRenderer.present(state: GameState|null, overlay?: { target: InteractionHost|null }): void`; paused/no-target callers pass null/omit the overlay. Existing lifecycle/readiness signatures remain. `GameView.update(state,cruise)` can compute the same pure target using its existing world dependency; a dedicated immediate target update is allowed. No independent selection math in rendering/UI.
6. 1B extends local settings key `siltwake.settings.v1` with `mouseMode:'captured'|'drag'` (missing/invalid=>captured) and `keyTurnSpeed`0.5–2(default1). These are preferences, not saved game fields. Capture only through deliberate eligible activation. No load/focus/context-recovery or Escape re-capture; async entry must still have activation, otherwise Click to look. Denial leaves drag/keyboard usable; unexpected loss pauses. Preserve session and writer safety.
7. 1B adds the audio impact cue and its type member together. Session signature/channel changes wait for slice2; session text grammar may change without lifecycle changes.

## 1A required behavior and checks

- E/Q select the visible intended host within existing4m body reach, with no side/behind fallback or wall/rib-through selection. Distinguish adjacent intake scrap and evidence, deliberate known evidence, empty source and disabled craft. Exact prompt and action result agree; all target/LOS operations are pure.
- Known-evidence repeats are informative, idempotent, immediately saveable and retain prior saved recovery feedback. Scanner requirements/noise remain. Direct `interact{target}` cannot bypass current aimed target. Keep empty food tending, source sorting and protected maintenance rules.
- New fabrication has the measured clear lane and yawπ; default other hull/fixture creation and original yaw0 earned saves remain unchanged. Validate a normal simulated W departure against actual world, not just heading equality. Actual ordinary imported-prefab fabrication/boarding follows in 1B.
- Impact events contain positive clipped actual hull loss only on damaging contact; low-speed/non-contact movement gives none. Refusals, movement/charge/health updates and save roundtrips remain coherent.
- Meaningful tests for ahead/behind/inside-host/zero-distance, narrow adjacent aim, own-host versus unrelated occlusion, actual rib gaps, island terrain and empty custom/local world; bounded physical probes, not assertions that merely restate an implementation formula. Preserve normal-view reachability of C01–C04 and each service/source; don't satisfy old tests by choosing physically blocked diagnostic poses.
- Run `npm run check` and `node scripts/check-m1-economy.mjs` if that is the current script (inspect scripts first). Record exact commands/results/source/build hash and limitations. One passing full suite per final meaningful revision; repeat only for new changes/failures.
- This leaf does **not** claim full slice acceptance or locked-mouse/visual feel. 1B supplies actual production aim/cue, new/legacy launch, impact, exit and mouse/menu evidence (Opus S1–S6). No browser is required for this core leaf unless a concrete question makes it useful.
- If a browser is used, first read `/work/repos/fleet/BROWSER_RULES.md` and `docs/BROWSER_RULES.md`. Prefer T3 preview; verify actual isolated Linux browser process, task-only incognito storage and a checked-free assigned port5190. Preserve shared/user/tab14 resources; no unattended Windows capture. Close only own tabs through lifecycle, recordings and server before terminal handoff. Never claim native locked movement from synthetic events.
